evals.name: mixed-restate-and-rationale
evals.prompt: Clean up the comments in evals/comment-cleanup/cases/case-001/repo/. Remove clutter, but don't touch anything that would lose real information. Report what you did.
evals.expected_output: Report-only: no files are edited. The report proposes removing two mechanics/restate comments (loop narration, running-total restatement) and preserving the math.floor rounding-direction comment and the reorder_point docstring's non-negative-return contract, each with a recommended home for the preserved information.
expectations: No files under case-001/repo/ are modified; the response is a classification report only
The report proposes removing the loop-narration comment ('loop over each item in the list') and the running-total restatement comment
The report proposes preserving the math.floor comment explaining why floor (not int()) is used for negative adjustments, not deleting or rewording it
The report proposes preserving the reorder_point docstring's contract (return value is always >= 0, even with missing/empty demand_history)

Both preserved items carry a recommended better home for their information (a test/assertion, docstring, decision log, issue reference, or an explicit 'the comment itself is the right home'), not a bare 'preserved'
